title: SAGE Vault Configuration
description: Top-level vault configuration schema. A domain instantiation produces a single YAML file that validates against this schema. Sub-schemas are referenced for document types, lifecycle, metadata extraction, and edge inference. See SAGE Architecture Reference Sections 4.7, 7.2, and 8.3.

id.description: Vault identifier. Unique within the CAS installation.

name.description: Human-readable display name for this vault.

description.description: Optional free-text description of this vault's purpose, surfaced in vault-listing UIs (e.g., the CAS Application dashboard). Null or absent when not set.

owner.description: User or team that owns this vault.

storage_root.description: Root directory for source files managed by this vault. Absolute path under the server's vault root. Must be outside cloud-synced directories.

brain_root.description: Directory holding this vault's local runtime artifacts (e.g. the timing log). Absolute path under the server's vault root. Must be outside cloud-synced directories.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/Chicago') used to derive document_date from source_modified_at when no filename or caller-supplied date is available. Defaults to UTC.

document_types.description: Document type definitions for this vault's domain vocabulary.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle state machine configuration for this vault.

edge_inference.description: Edge inference tier assignments and rules.

adapter_defaults.description: Per-adapter projection parameters, keyed by source type. Each entry is the vault-level base for that adapter; a per-request `config` deep-merges over it, request keys winning on collision. Adapter availability is not declared here: it is a process-wide capability fixed by the installed adapter implementations (CAS-ADR-046).

additionalProperties.description: Projection parameters for one adapter. Structure varies by source type; a key the receiving adapter does not read is ignored.

discovery_selection.description: Shared deterministic selection settings for every adapter. Optional keys name SelectionConfig limits; unspecified values use shared defaults. Positive integer values are bounded by shared hard maxima; unknown keys are refused. Request config deep-merges over these vault defaults.

discovery_facts.description: Shared source/parser inspection settings for every adapter: max_source_bytes, max_depth, max_parse_nodes, max_rows and max_columns. Positive integers use shared defaults and hard maxima. Structured projection admission enforces these limits before materializers; source_unreadable refuses excessive source or parse work.

dialect.description: For the markdown adapter: the Markdown dialect a document is read in, GFM or Pandoc Markdown. Unset, a document carrying a construct only Pandoc Markdown writes (a table ruled with dash lines, a grid table, a title block) is read as Pandoc Markdown and any other as GFM. A document read as Pandoc Markdown takes no heading from a table's rows or rules.

heading_style_map.description: For the docx adapter: maps Word paragraph style names to heading levels in the projection. Merged over the adapter's standard Heading 1 through Heading 9 defaults.

preview_rows.description: For the xlsx adapter: accepted for configuration compatibility; canonical projection includes every stored authored cell within parser limits regardless of this value. UI previews may use it as a presentation preference.

max_sheets.description: For the xlsx adapter: explicit cap on sheets projected from one workbook, in workbook order. A cap excluding sheets reports limited projection and keyword coverage. Null includes every sheet, including hidden sheets.

max_slides.description: For the pptx adapter: cap on slides projected from one deck.

max_pages.description: For the pdf adapter: cap on pages projected from one document.

abstraction.description: Bounded authored-evidence abstraction. Provider placement remains process-wide.

enabled.description: Whether to generate semantic abstracts during ingestion. If false, ingestion completes with pipeline_status 'abstraction_skipped'. If true and the LLM fails at runtime, pipeline_status is 'failed' (strict quality gate).

max_abstract_tokens.description: Legacy tuning remains accepted. Bounded abstraction clamps the effective output allowance to 1500 tokens and warns for larger legacy values.

base_abstract_tokens.description: Target allowance, not a minimum output length. Legacy values over 1500 remain accepted with a warning and an effective clamp.

tokens_per_word.description: Target tokens per selected authored word. Legacy scales over 1 remain accepted with a warning and an effective clamp; this is not full-source density.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts the abstraction worker makes for a queued document before stamping pipeline_status 'failed'. Applies only to queued work (concurrent ingest, reabstract, recompute, startup recovery); the synchronous wait-for-pipeline path remains fail-fast. The first attempt counts toward this total, so max_attempts=3 means one initial try plus two retries.

retry_backoff_base_seconds.description: Base delay in seconds for the abstraction worker's exponential retry backoff. The delay before retry k (1-indexed) is min(retry_backoff_base_seconds * 2**(k-1), retry_backoff_max_seconds).

retry_backoff_max_seconds.description: Upper bound in seconds on the abstraction worker's retry backoff delay, capping the exponential growth so a poison document cannot stall the queue indefinitely.

tokens_per_breadth.description: Target tokens per represented region/field pair, at most 32 pairs.

max_input_tokens.description: Per-call complete protected prompt ceiling; conservative UTF-8 byte token upper bounds.

max_generation_calls.description: Source-scope provider calls including startup probes; retained across retries and recovery.

max_total_output_tokens.description: Cumulative reserved output tokens, including startup probes.

retrieval_health.description: Configuration for retrieval health smoke tests (verify_vault_retrieval operation).

assertions_file.description: Path to a YAML file containing retrieval health assertions, relative to the vault's storage root and read through the vault-source store, as a document's source path is: from the local tree under the filesystem binding, and from the vault's document-store folder under the document-store binding. Each assertion specifies a query, an expected document ID, and a top-k threshold.

timing.description: Per-vault query-timing instrumentation configuration. Enables structured timing records on the storage, content, and retrieval layers, written to a per-vault rotating log file under brain_root.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, mcp_init wires the no-op timer to all services and the per-vault timing.log is never opened.

log_path.description: Absolute path for the per-vault timing log, under the server's vault root. When null (default), mcp_init resolves to {brain_root}/timing.log.

emit_threshold_ms.description: Fast-path skip threshold. Measurements below this are not formatted or logged individually; they bump a per-label counter that the periodic summary record consolidates.

warn_threshold_ms.description: Measurements above this are logged at WARNING; otherwise at DEBUG. Configurable per-vault so test cases can drive the WARN path on fast queries by lowering it.

summary_interval_seconds.description: Period at which the background flusher emits a summary record containing the per-label suppressed counts accumulated since the previous flush.

max_values.description: Inspected scalar facts: cells/native scalars or bounded narrative segments.

max_candidates.description: Retained distinct complete contextual discovery inputs.

max_tokens.description: Selected sizing tokens under the recorded tokenization identity, independently of model windows.

max_candidate_characters.description: Unicode characters in one complete tokenizer input, authored context included.

max_retained_bytes.description: UTF-8 input bytes plus reserved association payload storage.

max_keyword_characters.description: Authored passage content and structure admitted to keyword indexing, independently of embedding selection.

max_in_flight.description: Distinct complete embedding inputs held in one provider increment.

max_source_bytes.description: Source admission bytes before native materialization.

max_parse_nodes.description: Bounded syntax/parser work units; format-specific accounting is documented by shared policy.

max_rows.description: Native table/workbook source rows inspected or admitted.

max_columns.description: Inspected table/workbook columns; delimited parsing also enforces this bound.
